name: Prophet Massif and Signal Isle
frame: map metres, x east, y north, origin SW corner; yaw clockwise from north; hx along the pad's local x

sites.name: Prophet Monastery (citadel)
sites.stake: The monastery on the highest peak (420 m) holds the CIS sensor crown that watches the whole east and directs the Signal Isle battery; the next FOB

sites.name: Prophet Monastery (sensor crown)
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 80 x 80 m (as op 3's Peak Relay Dish); a second pad of the final, beside the citadel
sites.stake: The monastery on the highest peak (420 m) holds the CIS sensor crown that watches the whole east and directs the Signal Isle battery; the next FOB

sites.name: Signal Isle Turbolaser Battery
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 100 x 80 m (the Turbolaser Tower is 55 x 60 m)
sites.stake: Keeps the Republic fleet off the eastern sea; once it falls the fleet can close
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Kamar Strand Bunker Line
sites.comp: CIS Basic Trenchline with GPs + Tukata Turret Bunker
sites.size_note: KNOWN for the trenchline (2-12); the turret bunker is set into the line
sites.stake: Covers the black beach on the east; taking it opens the beach to boats and to the FOB's supply

sites.name: North Point Ferry Pens
sites.size_note: KNOWN: 82 x 65 m (the pad op 3 found for this composition)
sites.stake: The CIS ferry pens on the massif's north cape (Tanoa pier dressing) carry troops and shells across the 2 km channel to Signal Isle; blowing them cuts the battery's resupply and gives Republic boats the short hop

sites.name: Signal Ridge Comms
sites.size_note: KNOWN (built): your 1-13 pad of CIS Communications FOB with GPs, 88 x 104 m
sites.stake: The relay that links the battery to the monastery; cutting it leaves the battery firing blind
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Prophet Road Checkpoint
sites.stake: The road from the crest to the monastery; taking it opens the vehicle way up

sites.name: Massif AA
sites.comp: CIS Heavy AA Tower w Interior GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Flower Tower (1-11)
sites.stake: Covers the north channel and the eastern sky; taking it opens the air route to Signal Isle

sites.name: Prophet Limestone Quarry
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 120 x 90 m of terraced dig (160 x 120 m found no seat within 840 m)
sites.stake: Pale limestone for the Yard's foundry; a big terraced dig and the covered climb to the summit

sites.name: Kamar Refuelling Base
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Fuel Depot (1-12)
sites.stake: Fuel for the beach depot and the boats; it burns when hit

sites.name: East Slope Gun Line
sites.comp: CIS Small Artillery Base with GPs
sites.stake: Guns over the east beaches; air softens them

sites.name: North Point Pillboxes
sites.size_note: KNOWN as built: your 1-09 with this pick is a Small Rectangle FOB, 90 x 58 m
sites.stake: Pillboxes over the ferry pens' beach cover the north channel

sites.name: Signal Isle Landing
sites.stake: Supply landings on Signal Isle's south-west beach; taking it opens that beach to boats
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Signal Isle Depot
sites.size_note: REDUCED: your built pad (1-06, 134 x 248 m) holds 4 m nowhere within 720 m; this 80 x 60 m pad needs a trimmed composition. Was: ASSUMED: 80 x 60 m
sites.stake: The battery's ammunition; it burns when hit
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Kalam Rock Chapel
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 30 x 30 m on the east rock (a cliff work: may come to the water's edge)
sites.stake: A cliff chapel (Altis chapel dressing) on the east rock, used as the battery's spotter
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: North Cape AA
sites.comp: CIS AA Tooth Fixed with GPs
sites.stake: Covers the north-east sky; taking it opens the northern air route to the battery
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Deep-Sea Sensor Stack
sites.size_note: REDUCED / ASSUMED: the stack top takes about 30 x 30 m (the dish and a ring of guns); air only
sites.stake: Spots the fleet's eastern anchorage for the battery; killing it blinds the battery's long shots. Only air can reach it
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Kamar Landers
sites.comp: CIS Lander Base Fixed with GPs (D)
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Landing Position (1-02); a beach work
sites.stake: Landers on the south end of the strand; taking them opens a second beach

sites.name: Upper Spring Outpost
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 60 x 60 m (as op 3's Zavala outpost); seated beside the west climb road below the spring (the spring's own ridge at 385 m takes no road)
sites.stake: Holds the spring below the summit, the monastery's water, on the west climb

6-F Prophet Monastery: by road from Causeway Foot (op 4's net) up the west climb, past the Upper Spring Outpost (6-14) and the Prophet Road Checkpoint (6-02) (vehicles)
the covered climb up the quarry (6-04) from the north-west, on foot
6-M1 Signal Isle Turbolaser Battery: by boat to the Signal Isle Landing (6-08) beach, then up past the Signal Ridge Comms (6-M4)
by boat or air to the north cape under the North Cape AA (6-11), then up the north slope
6-M2 Kamar Strand Bunker Line: by boat to the black beach of Kamar Strand (shores list)
by road down from the massif past the refuelling base (6-05) (vehicles)
6-M3 North Point Ferry Pens: by road from the Massif AA (6-03) (vehicles)
by boat to the north point beach under the pillboxes (6-07)
6-M4 Signal Ridge Comms: from the Signal Isle Landing (6-08) up the ridge
by air once the North Cape AA (6-11) falls
